South Pole Landing

NASA Space Apps · Lunar South Pole

Choosing a landing site

Four candidate sites, each with a chosen flat region of interest (ROI). Drag the time slider to watch the Sun, Earth and Moon move over one year, from 1 Dec 2026 UTC, and see when an ROI has both sunlight and a view of Earth.

WebGL is not available in this browser, so the 3D scene cannot be shown. The charts and tables below still work.
